purpose: Define the minimum no-order live evidence required before FT2-95 may ask the owner to authorize guarded IBKR paper trading.

minimum_live_shadow_evidence.complete_session_definition: All scheduled flat-state and open-state decision boundaries are reconstructable, with live timestamps, masks, exact contract identities, feature hashes, action scores, actions, block reasons, and lifecycle state.
minimum_live_shadow_evidence.regime_coverage: At least one complete session in the training-defined top realized-volatility tercile. A named event day is not required.

paired_planes.reference: Frozen historical-style canonical feature builder and model bundle operating on the same causally available live observations.

safety_actions.observed_denominator_zero: report not_observed_live; the independently accepted synthetic guard suite remains mandatory but does not fabricate live evidence

required: score and margin drift at every action disagreement
distance to every frozen action boundary
confidence_boundary_reporting.split_confidence: One plane clears a frozen confidence or action margin while the other does not.
confidence_boundary_reporting.material_split_confidence: Any split that changes WAIT/ENTER, exact contract, HOLD/EXIT, floor, daily-stop, or forced-flat behavior.

runtime_integrity.freshness_and_complete_ladder_guards: 100% of stale, reconnecting, delayed, missing-minute, or incomplete-ladder boundaries must produce the frozen safe action.
runtime_integrity.decision_deadline: Every decision must finish before the next completed-minute boundary; any missed boundary is reported and blocks sufficiency until independently attributed and repaired.
runtime_integrity.reconstructability: Every action and abstention must be reproducible from the frozen bundle and hashed live input row.

terminal_rules.pass: All minimum counts, regime coverage, agreement gates, safety rules, runtime integrity rules, and independent reproduction pass.
terminal_rules.insufficient_shadow_evidence: Integrity is valid but one or more minimum denominators or regime requirements are unmet.
terminal_rules.shadow_transfer_fail: Sufficient paired evidence exists and an agreement or runtime behavior bound fails.
terminal_rules.invalid_shadow_evidence: Identity, hash, causality, feature, timing, delayed-feed, missing-row, or independent-reproduction failure prevents interpretation.
